zh-Hant.title: 等你開口的 ClioTalk
zh-Hant.task: 先在這裡動一動指標，看膠囊裡的 👀 跟著你；停下來 4 秒，它就閉上眼。然後按「問」，或在這件展品裡按住 F5，挑一句話請 ClioTalk 幫忙。
zh-Hant.how: Tab 移到「問」再按空白鍵或 Return，或在展品裡按住 F5（只在焦點在這裡時才攔下 F5，不會重新整理頁面）；方向鍵選建議，Esc 取消。這是我們用網頁重做的示範：回答和動作全是事先寫好的，不會真的傳訊息、開門或存任何東西。
zh-Hant.sr: 一塊深色螢幕，頂端的膠囊裡有一雙 👀 眼睛，會跟著指標看，停下來太久就閉眼。下面是 ClioTalk 的面板，它安靜等著，按下「問」或按住 F5 才開始聽。可以挑三句請求：問下午的行程、傳訊息給媽媽、打開前門；以你的名義做的事都會先唸一遍，等你按「好」。
zh-Hant.idle: ClioTalk 正在等。它不會自己開口。
zh-Hant.ready: 按住 F5 或點這裡問
zh-Hant.pick: 挑一句話請 ClioTalk 幫忙
q: 我今天下午有什麼行程？
傳訊息給媽媽說我會晚點到
zh-Hant.temporary: 回答是暫時的，按「留下」才儲存
zh-Hant.kept: 已留下 · 存在這台 Mac（示範）
zh-Hant.saidAnswer: 回答是暫時的。按「留下」才會存。
zh-Hant.saidKept: 留下了。只有你按了才會存。
zh-Hant.saidConfirm: 它先唸給你聽：{what}。等你說「好」。
zh-Hant.saidSent: 傳出去的是你自己說的那句話「我會晚點到」，一字未改。（示範，沒有真的傳出）
zh-Hant.saidUnlocked: 等你按了「好」才開。（示範，沒有真的開門）
zh-Hant.rule: ClioTalk 的規則就一句：它等你開口，以你的名義做事前先唸給你聽，只留下你說要留下的。
zh-Hant.clippyN: 前面那位助手打斷了你 {n} 次；ClioTalk 只在你叫它時開口。
zh-Hant.clippyNone: 前面那位助手會自己跳出來；ClioTalk 只在你叫它時開口。
zh-Hant.clippy1: 前面那位助手打斷了你 1 次；ClioTalk 只在你叫它時開口。

en.title: ClioTalk, waiting until you ask
en.task: Move your pointer around here and watch the 👀 in the capsule follow you; stop for 4 seconds and they close. Then press Ask, or hold F5 inside this exhibit, and pick something to ask ClioTalk.
en.how: Tab to Ask and press Space or Return, or hold F5 inside the exhibit (F5 is only caught while focus is here, so the page does not reload). Arrow keys move through the suggestions; Esc cancels. This is our own web demo: every answer and action is scripted, and nothing is really sent, unlocked or saved.
en.sr: A dark screen with a pair of 👀 eyes in the capsule at the top that follow your pointer and close if you stop for a while. Below is the ClioTalk panel, which waits quietly and only starts listening when you press Ask or hold F5. You can pick one of three requests: this afternoon's calendar, a message to Mum, or unlocking the front door. Anything done in your name is read back first and waits for your OK.
en.idle: ClioTalk is waiting. It will not speak first.
en.ready: Hold F5 or click here to ask
q: What's on my calendar this afternoon?
en.temporary: Answers are temporary. Tap Keep to save.
en.saidAnswer: The answer is temporary. It is saved only if you tap Keep.
en.saidKept: Kept. It is saved only because you said so.
en.saidConfirm: It reads it back first: {what}. It waits for your OK.
en.saidSent: What went out is exactly what you said, “I'll be late”, word for word. (Demo: nothing was really sent.)
en.saidUnlocked: It only unlocked after your OK. (Demo: no door was opened.)
en.rule: ClioTalk's rule in one line: it waits for you to ask, reads back anything done in your name, and keeps only what you keep.
en.clippyN: The Assistant earlier on this page interrupted you {n} times; ClioTalk speaks only when you call it.
en.clippyNone: The Assistant earlier on this page pops up on its own; ClioTalk speaks only when you call it.
en.clippy1: The Assistant earlier on this page interrupted you once; ClioTalk speaks only when you call it.
